categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Jindao Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of various forklift and industrial vehicle transmissions. Its main products include mechanical transmission gearboxes, hydraulic transmission gearboxes, electric forklift gearboxes, wet drive axles, integrated axle boxes, and main reducers. The company also provides overall technical solutions for industrial vehicle transmission systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed a comprehensive core technology system including noise analysis and control (NVH), gear optimization design, electro-hydraulic control (TCU), and mechatronic control technologies. It covers mechanical, hydraulic, and electric transmission technologies. Production methods emphasize customized and semi-customized manufacturing, with advanced CNC machining centers and rigorous quality control to ensure precision, durability, and noise reduction. The company also invests in automation and flexible manufacturing lines to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major domestic and international forklift and industrial vehicle manufacturers, including Hangcha Group, Mitsubishi Logisnext, Toyota, Clark, and others. The company serves primarily the forklift industry, which is widely used in manufacturing, logistics, transportation, warehousing, postal services, wholesale, retail, and rental sectors. The domestic market is dominant, but the company is actively expanding its international customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province. It also has a growing presence in overseas markets, supplying products to international forklift manufacturers in Europe, Japan, and other regions. Domestic sales account for over 94% of revenue, with exports making up about 5%.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Jindao Technology is positioned in the midstream of the forklift industry supply chain, specializing in the manufacturing of key transmission components and assemblies. It sources raw materials and components such as steel, hydraulic parts, and electronic control systems from upstream suppliers and supplies finished transmission systems to downstream forklift OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation driven by technology, focusing on developing high-end, intelligent, and energy-efficient transmission products. Key R&D directions include hydraulic and electric transmission gearboxes for new energy forklifts, intelligent control systems, and integration of electric drive units. It invests significantly in R&D (about 4.5% of revenue) and collaborates closely with customers for co-development. The company also emphasizes internationalization and digital transformation aligned with Industry 4.0.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized and semi-customized transmission products and components to forklift and industrial vehicle manufacturers. The company operates a direct sales model, serving as a first-tier supplier. It also extends services by offering integrated solutions including maintenance and aftermarket support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the forklift transmission sector, recognized as one of the earliest private enterprises in this field in China. It competes with domestic giants like Hangcha Group and Anhui Heli, as well as international manufacturers from Europe, Japan, and Taiwan. While international firms dominate the high-end hydraulic transmission market, Zhejiang Jindao leverages cost advantages and technological innovation to expand market share domestically and internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 621 million, a slight decrease of 4.58% from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 42.7 million, down 13.04%. The company has total assets of around RMB 1.66 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.32 billion. Despite short-term revenue decline, the company maintains stable profitability and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Jindao Technology emphasizes its comprehensive product line, high-quality and reliable products, and strong R&D capabilities as its core competitive advantages. It offers customized transmission solutions tailored to customer needs, integrating advanced noise control, energy efficiency, and intelligent control technologies. The company’s early entry and accumulated industry experience create high entry barriers, while its focus on new energy and intelligent transmissions positions it well for future market trends.
